name: chronus
description: Schedule Claude Code tasks from Markdown plan files.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Schedule Claude Code tasks from Markdown plans.
[Open Manager](command:chronus.openManager)
[Schedule a Markdown file](command:chronus.addFiles)

chronus.claudePath.markdownDescription: Path to the `claude` executable. Leave as `claude` to resolve from PATH.

chronus.libraryPath.markdownDescription: Folder holding your plan library. Leave empty to use Chronus's own storage. Changing this does not move existing plans; already-scheduled tasks keep working either way, since they store absolute paths.

chronus.resultsPath.markdownDescription: Folder for run transcripts — one subfolder per plan, one Markdown file per run. Leave empty to use a `results` folder beside your plan library. These are never deleted automatically, unlike raw logs.

chronus.showTerminalOnRun.description: Reveal the terminal panel when a task starts. Focus is left where it is. Turn off if scheduled runs interrupt you.

chronus.maxConcurrent.description: Maximum number of tasks running at once. Raise deliberately: parallel agents editing one repository will collide.

chronus.maxRetries.description: Retry attempts after a failed run before the task is given up on.

chronus.retryDelayMinutes.description: Delay before retrying a failed run.

chronus.graceWindowMinutes.description: How late a task may fire and still run. Beyond this it is marked missed and waits for your decision instead of running unattended.

chronus.idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Kill a run that produces no output for this long.

chronus.maxRuntimeMinutes.description: Hard wall-clock ceiling on a single run.

chronus.logRetentionDays.markdownDescription: Delete raw run logs older than this on startup. This does not touch the Markdown transcripts in `chronus.resultsPath`, which are kept indefinitely.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build && vsce package
